title: 高分子化学
subtitle: Polymer Chemistry
keywords: Polymer 2.Types of polymer 3.Molecular weight distribution 4.Glass transition temperature 5.Thermoplastic properties
educationalGoal: You learn the characteristics of polymeric materials necessary for basic knowledge of chemical engineers compared with low molecular weight materials. And you understand the physical properties, synthesis methods and applications of polymers.
advice: 1. What is polymer (structure, thermal properties, viscoelasticity, strength as a material, etc) ? 2. How many types of polymers are classified? 3. Synthesis and molding methods of polymers. 4. Explain each polymer with properties and applications (Applications of polymer such as functional polymers)? 5. Testing methods for the mechanical strength of polymers Every time, prepare and review. Keeping in mind that our life can not be done without polymers, studying with interest.
books: Textbooks: Kenji Yokota(2016), Koubunshi wo manabou (Kagaku-Dojin Publishing Company,INC) Reference Books: Unspecified Reserved Books in the Library: Shouhei Inoue(2006), Hajimete no Koubunshi Kagaku(Kagaku-Dojin Publishing Company,INC)
requiredKnowledge: Let's examine what kind of plastics, rubber, fiber, adhesive, paint are around us. These are all polymers.

activityGoals.body: Find out what kind of position the polymer is in the materials.
Understand the type and properties of polymers synthesized by humans on the market.
Explain the molecular weights and molecular weight distribution of the polymer.
Understand crystal part and amorphous part of polymers.
Understand the glass transition temperature and melting point.
Explain the difference in properties between thermoplastic resin and thermosetting resin.

achievementLevels.ideal: It is possible to accurately explain the following issues. The difference between polymer material and low molecular weight material. Several kinds of polymer can be said and it can explain exactly what kind of field it is used. The molecular weight and molecular weight distribution of polymer. The difference between the crystal part and the amorphous part of polymer. The characteristic glass transition point of polymer. The difference (kind, applied field, etc.) between thermoplastic resin and thermosetting resin.
achievementLevels.standard: It is possible to explain the following issues. The difference between polymer material and low molecular weight material. Several kinds of polymer can be said and it can explain exactly what kind of field it is used. The molecular weight and molecular weight distribution of the polymer. The difference between the crystal part and the amorphous part of the polymer. The characteristic glass transition point of polymer. The difference (kind, applied field, etc.) between thermoplastic resin and thermosetting resin.

lessons.assignments: Check the syllabus and understand the themes of class content, overview, learning, learning goals, etc. Preliminary review / review on the type of polymer.

Learn about the definition of macromolecules, the difference between macromolecules and low molecules, the molecular weight and molecular weight distribution of macromolecules. Prep: p 9 - 18 come read. Review: Reflecting on textbooks and notes, conduct exercise 2.1.

Study on the basic structure and copolymerization of polymer repeatedly and on the difference between thermoplastic resin and thermosetting resin. Prep: p19-28 come read. Review: Reflecting on textbooks and notes, practice question 3.1-3.3.
Learn about the three-dimensional structure of macromolecules. Prep: p.29-37 come read. Review: Reflecting textbooks and notes and exercises 4.1, 5.1a.
Learn about crystal part and amorphous part of polymer. Prep: p59-67 come read. Review: Review the textbooks and notes and exercise questions 8.1 and 8.2.
Cooperative bonding, intermolecular force, molecular cohesive energy Molecular cohesion energy is studied. Prep: p69-76 come read. Review: Review the textbooks and notes and exercise 9.1-9.2.

lessons.content: Learn about tensile test, S-S curve, additives
lessons.operation: Lecture, Exercise and Discussion Short test
lessons.assignments: Review the part you have learned so far and go to the exam. Review: Review the textbooks and notes
Learn about melting point and boiling point of polymer. Prep: p95 - 101 come read. Review: Reflecting on textbooks and notes, practice question 12.1.

lessons.content: Difference between low molecular weight and high molecular weight from the viewpoint of Tg, Tm, bp
lessons.assignments: Looking at lecture notes on the difference between low molecular weight and high molecular weight from the viewpoint of Tg, Tm, bp.
Learn about macromolecular viscoelasticity, spring and piston, relaxation time. Prep: p103-110 come read. Review: Reflecting on textbooks and notes, practice exercises 13.1.
Learn about entropy elasticity and vulcanization. Prep: p 87-94 come read. Review: Review the textbooks and notes and exercise 11.1.
Prepare about environmental problems with functional polymers and plastics. Prep: p111-122 come read. Review: Reflecting on textbooks and notes, practice exercises 14.1.
Learn about polyaddition, addition condensation, sequential polymerization, polycondensation. Prep: p 125-138 come read. Review: Looking back on textbooks and notes, practice question 15.1.

lessons.content: Molding of polymer Commentary on the points of lectures from 1 to 14 times and final Examination
lessons.assignments: Learn about injection molding, extrusion molding, compression molding, vacuum molding. Prep: p139-141come read. Review: Reflecting on textbooks and notes, practice question 16.1. Review the contents of the lecture so far.
